Uniform

/YOO-nuh-form/ · adjective

Hear It

What It Means

Something that is uniform is consistent or of similar form.

All the students wore uniform jackets for the school photo.

Worked Example

A quality inspector pulls fifty tiles from the kiln and lines them up under bright light. Each one is the identical shade of gray, the identical size, the identical thickness — she cannot tell any tile from its neighbor.

The batch shows no variation at all from piece to piece, which is exactly what uniform describes. Uniform is more precise than 'similar' because similar things can still differ slightly, while uniform means the same in every respect throughout.

How Uniform Sits Among Its Neighbors

Synonyms — open each to see how it differs

consistent

consistent: staying the same over time

identical

identical: exactly alike in every detail

unvarying

unvarying: never changing in any way

Antonyms

varied

varied: having many different forms or types

inconsistent

inconsistent: changing irregularly rather than staying same

How Strong Is It? — similar → consistent → identical → uniform

similar vs. uniform

similar vs. uniform: Similar is weaker than uniform — similar things merely resemble each other, while uniform things are the same in form all the way through.

consistent vs. uniform

consistent vs. uniform: Consistent is weaker than uniform; consistent means staying steady over time, but uniform means every single piece matches every other piece.

identical vs. uniform

identical vs. uniform: Identical is stronger than uniform — uniform items match in overall form, while identical items are exact copies down to the smallest detail.

Build the Word

The pieces

prefix — uni-

prefix — uni-: one (Latin (unus))

root — form

root — form: shape (Latin (forma))

Put it together

Put it together: Uni- (one) + form (shape): uniform literally means 'having one shape' — consistent and the same in form throughout.

Use the root in a new word: unify

Use the root in a new word: unify: The new coach worked to unify the team after a losing season.

Word Choice

Uniform describes something that stays consistent throughout without variation (uniform temperature, uniform policy), and often appears alongside verbs like 'ensure' or 'maintain' when the point is achieving that consistency.
